faq.q1: What is included in the Free plan?
faq.a1: You can record vitals and symptoms, view your full health history, enter logs by voice without limits, check in every day, and open Early Signals on demand. Free covers 1 protected person and 1 Care Circle connection.
faq.q2: How is An Tam different from Free?
faq.a2: An Tam adds AI call center follow-up after a missed check-in, sequential calls to family until someone confirms, automatic Early Signals for the family, and protection for multiple people in one plan.
faq.q3: How do An Tam 2, 4, and 8 differ?
faq.a3: All plans include the same An Tam features and differ only in the number of protected people. Annual plans also include the matching number of specialist consultations: 2, 4, or 8.
faq.q4: Who counts as a protected person?
faq.a4: A protected person checks in every day and can receive an AI call center follow-up when needed. The plan owner selects protected people from accepted Care Circle connections.
faq.q5: Do emergency contacts use protected-person slots?
faq.a5: No. Slots only count protected people. Emergency contacts receive information and help coordinate a check when something needs attention.
faq.q6: What happens after someone misses a check-in?
faq.a6: Free sends an in-app notification to one family member. With An Tam, the AI call center calls the protected person first, then calls emergency contacts in order until someone confirms they will check.
faq.a7: Free users can open a result on demand. With An Tam, Asinu evaluates signals periodically, shares results with the family, and alerts them when signals worsen. This is screening and guidance information, not a diagnosis.
faq.q8: How do annual specialist consultation gifts work?
faq.a8: Each protected person on an annual An Tam plan receives 1 dr.asinu specialist consultation. An Tam 2, 4, and 8 include 2, 4, and 8 consultations respectively. Gifts activate when dr.asinu launches; monthly plans do not include them.
faq.q9: How are payment, renewal, and refunds handled?
faq.a9: Payment is processed through the App Store or Google Play. Plans renew automatically until canceled in Store settings. You may request a refund within 14 days; approval follows Store policy.
faq.q10: Can I change plans or protected people?
faq.a10: Yes. The plan owner can update protected people within the plan limit. When you choose another plan, the Store handles the remaining price and term according to its upgrade or plan-change policy.
